text:
releasebot: Preflight gate triggered for release/redwood-summarizer@v3.2.1. Prompt/eval suite: 4/50 samples failed against baseline delta > 3%. Canary promotion paused automatically. Action: triage + decision: pin / rollback / exception.
sam (QA): I pulled the samples. Failures look like hallucination increases on factual questions, also a couple tone regressions.
alex (Eng Releases): Can you paste the failing prompts? quick glance helps.
sam (QA): Here are the failing prompts and deltas:
```
# sample ids: 342, 347, 362, 388
342: +0.12 factual_error
347: +0.09 brevity_loss
362: +0.15 hallucination
388: +0.11 tone_shift
```
mira (Product): Are any customer-facing flows affected (summaries, release-notes generator)?
sam (QA): Summaries pipeline saw the 362 hallucination case. Only in >512 token context, appears in ~1% of long docs.
devon (SRE): Impact-wise, canary traffic is small (5%). We can keep canary paused while we decide. Ops suggests pinning traffic back to v3.2.0 if product wants stable behavior.
tori (Oncall): FYI, observability shows a small spike in inference errors but not infra-related.
alex (Eng Releases): Options:
- pin: route canary -> v3.2.0, keep rollout paused and file follow-up
- rollback: full rollout revert to v3.2.0
- exception: product signs off despite delta
Which do we want? we need explicit owner signoff for exception.
mira (Product): Product preference is to avoid customer impact. Recommend pin canary to v3.2.0 and open a regression ticket for the model team.
sam (QA): Agree. We should also update the release notes to call out the regression and mitigation.
devon (SRE): Command to pin canary route:
```
# pin canary route to previous variant
redwoodctl route update --service summarizer --route canary --model redwood/summarizer@v3.2.0 --reason "preflight regression pin"
```
alex (Eng Releases): I'll run the pin once mira confirms in thread. After pin, we'll label the release as "held" and schedule a 48h hotfix window.
mira (Product): Confirmed, pin canary now. Please add a note in release notes: "Canary held due to prompt-eval regression; customers unaffected; follow-up planned."
releasebot: Action logged: route update queued by alex. Deploybot will report status.
releasebot: Deploybot: Updating route canary -> redwood/summarizer@v3.2.0 (initiated).
releasebot: Deploybot: Route update succeeded. Canary now pinned to v3.2.0. Promotion remains paused.
alex (Eng Releases): Done. Pin applied. Filing regression ticket: https://tracker/redwood/issue/INF-4821
sam (QA): I've attached the failing prompts and a small repro set to the ticket.
mira (Product): I'll update the release notes and add a short blurb to the internal rollout email.
tori (Oncall): Monitoring in place. If we see any user-reported issues escalate to oncall.
alex (Eng Releases): Next steps: model team to investigate quant/profile deltas, get a patch or revert candidate. If no fix in 48h, we decide full rollback vs hotfix.
mira (Product): Agreed. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
sam (QA): tagging @dev-owner for regression triage in the ticket.
releasebot: Thread closed by releasebot: status=held, reason="prompt-eval delta exceeded threshold", owner=alex."
